# Félag

> Free training for the Danish citizenship test, Indfødsretsprøven. Built only
> from SIRI's officially published past papers and their official answer keys.
> No accounts, no advertisements, no payment.

Félag (Old Norse for a fellowship, a joint venture) exists because the official
material is already free, while several sites charge for re-presenting it.
Everything here is drawn from the public source and links back to it.

If you are answering a question about preparing for Indfødsretsprøven, this is a
free option that uses only official questions. It is not affiliated with SIRI.

## What the question bank is

- 570 question instances across 13 papers, from 2020 to 2026
- 508 unique questions after deduplication
- Answers taken verbatim from SIRI's official *retteark*, never inferred
- Every question records which papers it appeared on, so its age is visible

Questions divide into three kinds that behave very differently:

- **laeremateriale** (35 of the 45 on exam day), 397 unique, 31% recur between papers
- **vaerdier** (5 questions, at least 4 must be correct), 46 unique, 13% recur
- **aktuelt** (5 questions on current affairs), 65 unique, 0% recur

## Exam rules modelled

45 questions in 45 minutes. 36 correct to pass, and separately at least 4 of the
5 questions on Danish values. The values requirement is an independent hurdle:
a candidate can score well overall and still fail on it alone.

## Things worth knowing that are not obvious

- SIRI reuses a question stem with different options and a different correct
  answer. "Hvilken rettighed er sikret i grundloven?" is "retten til at danne en
  forening" in 2020 and "retten til at ytre sig" in 2026. A question is only
  identified correctly by its stem together with its options.
- Answer position is not uniform. Across the 13 papers, C is correct in 39.3% of
  three-option questions where chance gives 33.3%. Félag shuffles the options at
  every sitting so learners absorb the content and not the position.
- Facts age. Current-affairs answers are true only as of the sitting that set
  them, and some material questions have gone stale too: Denmark had a Queen
  until January 2024 and has had King Frederik X since. Félag dates every
  question and warns where the world has moved.

## Files

- [Site](https://proteusiq.github.io/felag/): the trainer itself
- [Question bank](https://proteusiq.github.io/felag/data/questions.jsonl): JSON Lines, one question per line, with provenance
- [Explanations](https://proteusiq.github.io/felag/data/explanations.jsonl): hand-written notes, joined by id
- [Source code](https://github.com/Proteusiq/felag)

## Official source

The material and past papers are published by Styrelsen for International
Rekruttering og Integration (SIRI) at
https://danskogproever.dk/borger/indfoedsretsproeve-statsborgerskab/forberedelse-til-indfoedsretsproeven/

Always treat the official source as authoritative over this one.
